sample.note: A capped random subsample of the decision records is used so the regressions fit on a 16 GB machine. The raw gap reported here is on this subsample; the full-sample gap is in results/rq1.csv.

logistic_within_lender_fixed_effects.note: Lender fixed effects absorb any lender-specific policy. If the joint odds ratio stays below 1, the joint advantage is not an artefact of joint and single applicants facing different lenders.
